thread:
maya: Opening a small PR to tighten SLO wording in the Dedicated provisioning guide. Theres some language that reads too definitive for p95 numbers. Need quick UX + eng review.

liam: Thanks. Can you also add a one-line bash snippet that shows how to fetch tenant quotas via the CLI? Ops asks for that in the runbook.

maya: Will do. Draft bash snippet:
```bash
# get tenant quota
redwoodctl dedicated describe --tenant acme-42 --region us-west-2
```

sam: For the SLO table, prefer "illustrative target" column instead of plain numbers. Also add a short callout: "not a contract; contact sales for contractual SLAs".

priscilla: I'll add a tiny JS SDK example and link to examples/dedicated/cli-and-sdk.md. JS example: 
```js
await client.dedicated.getQuota({ tenantId: 'acme-42' });
```

yuki: On isolation wording: suggest we replace "no preemption" with "preemption disabled under typical load" and include an example scenario where preemption can still occur (extreme capacity pressure + region failover). Keeps expectations accurate.

maya: Good phrasing. Updated PR text and added scenario paragraph. Also fixed two broken links: the CLI page moved and the TF module path changed.

docs-bot: PR opened by maya: PR #1333  "docs(dedicated): SLO wording & quick CLI/SDK snippets". Requested reviewers: liam, priscilla. Preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-1333 (queued)

liam: Left inline comment: for the bash snippet add `--output json` so scripts can parse it.

maya: Updated snippet to:
```bash
redwoodctl dedicated describe --tenant acme-42 --region us-west-2 --output json
```

priscilla: Pushed the JS example and a short Terraform mapping example showing how to set `reserved_pool` flags. Small note: include a validation example when reserved pools are at capacity.

sam: Quick nit: make the SLO table rows explicit that numbers are per-model and dependent on sequence length. Add a short footnote.

yuki: Also add a short FAQ blurb: "What does reservation buy me?" -> list: prioritized routing, preferred reserved capacity, reduced preemption risk, but still subject to regional constraints.

maya: Added FAQ and a footnote about model/sequence impact. Pushed.

docs-bot: Preview build updated for PR #1333  status: queued.

liam: :thumbsup: on edits. I'll approve after CI.

maya: Thanks folks  merging after 2 approvals + green CI. If anyone sees wording that could be read as contractual, flag it here.
